descriptionChirho: To redeem or ransom someone by paying a price, delivering from bondage, danger, or death — the core Qal active meaning across all finite forms, imperatives, and infinitives.
Those who have been redeemed or ransomed, used as a substantive noun referring to the people God has delivered.
The one who redeems or acts as redeemer, used as a participial descriptor of the agent who performs redemption.
To be redeemed or ransomed, the passive voice indicating the subject receives the action of redemption.
To cause or allow someone to be redeemed, the causative stem indicating the subject enables another's redemption.
The state or process of being redeemed, the passive of the causative stem indicating redemption received through another's agency.
